{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'completed' status
print("Unique values in 'status':", sales['status'].unique())

# Check if 'revenue' is present and has valid values
print("First few 'revenue' values:", sales['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for any other suspicious revenue values
print("Unique revenue values (first 10):", sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])"}
